# Express Septic Tank Pumping

> Owner-operated septic tank pumping company based in Estero, Florida, serving Lee, Collier and Charlotte County plus LaBelle (Hendry County). Residential septic pumping starts at $399.99.

## Contact
- Business: Express Septic Tank Pumping LLC
- Address: 23357 Olde Meadowbrook Circle, Estero, FL 34134
- Phone: (239) 451-3261
- Hours: open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Email: expressseptictankpumping@gmail.com
- Online requests: https://book.servicem8.com/request_booking?uuid=019fca12-b6bf-721c-8a2b-41d89e1a1b5b (a request; the business contacts the customer to confirm a time)
- Google reviews: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=796203008963075980

## Services and prices
- [Residential septic tank pumping](https://expresssepticpumping.com/residential-septic-tank-pumping/): from $399.99. Standard pricing covers a pump-out that starts before 2:30 PM. Emergency work, and any job that starts after 2:30 PM, is billed at the after-hours rate. A $50 travel fee applies to jobs more than 30 minutes from our base; dispatch tells you on the call if it applies. Locating a buried lid depends on the site and is quoted on the call.
- [Septic tank riser installation](https://expresssepticpumping.com/septic-tank-riser-installation/): 6-inch risers $299.99 each. A riser brings the tank lid up to ground level so future pump-outs don't need digging.
- Buried lid locating and digging: quoted on the call
- After-hours pumping: $699.99–$799.99 by home size
- [Commercial grease trap service](https://expresssepticpumping.com/commercial-grease-trap-service/): short overview of commercial grease trap service in Southwest Florida. The main page is [grease trap and interceptor pumping](https://expresssepticpumping.com/grease-trap-pumping/).
- [Septic repair](https://expresssepticpumping.com/septic-repair/): quoted after we look at the system. Repair work performed under Florida Certified Plumbing Contractor Raymond F. Dibble, License #CFC020332.
- [Drain field replacement](https://expresssepticpumping.com/drain-field-replacement/): quoted after we inspect the system. The work is performed under FL Certified Plumbing Contractor Raymond F. Dibble, License #CFC020332.
- [Lift station pumping](https://expresssepticpumping.com/lift-station-pumping/): Express pumps lift stations in Estero and across Southwest Florida. Quoted after we inspect the system. Call (239) 451-3261.
- [Grease trap and interceptor pumping](https://expresssepticpumping.com/grease-trap-pumping/): main page for restaurants and food service in Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Bonita Springs, Naples, Estero and across Lee, Collier and Charlotte County, plus LaBelle, including in-ground grease interceptors and indoor traps. $695 for a 1,000-gallon grease trap or interceptor; other sizes are quoted. We can set up a recurring pump-out schedule. The 4,200-gallon truck is split for septic and grease, so the two never mix. Lee County Ordinance 14-24 requires grease interceptors to be fully pumped at least every 90 calendar days. Indoor grease traps must be cleaned at least weekly or whenever grease and solids exceed 20% of the unit volume. Florida Statute 403.0741 requires a signed grease waste service manifest for every pump-out. Call (239) 451-3261.
- [Grease trap pumping service areas](https://expresssepticpumping.com/grease-trap-pumping-service-areas/): hub listing restaurant grease trap and interceptor city pages in Southwest Florida.
- [Grease trap pumping in Bonita Springs](https://expresssepticpumping.com/grease-trap-pumping-bonita-springs-fl/): restaurant grease traps and interceptors in Bonita Springs. BSU sewer customers follow BSU's 90-day interceptor rule and 25% wetted-height trigger. $695 for a 1,000-gallon unit.
- [Grease trap pumping in Estero](https://expresssepticpumping.com/grease-trap-pumping-estero-fl/): Estero kitchens may be on Lee County Utilities or Bonita Springs Utilities; confirm the provider. $695 for a 1,000-gallon unit.

## How we stand apart
- If we commit to a same-day pump-out, we keep working into the night until every scheduled job is done.
- We pump both the inlet and the outlet compartments. Some companies only pump the inlet.
- [Why we pump both tanks, by city](https://expresssepticpumping.com/why-we-pump-both-tanks-service-areas/): city pages on emptying the inlet and outlet chambers, what a one-sided pump-out leaves behind, and what to ask any pumper.
- [Why we pump both compartments in Bonita Springs](https://expresssepticpumping.com/why-we-pump-both-tanks-bonita-springs-fl/): both-chamber pump-outs for Bonita homes still on a tank, including during BSU sewer conversions.
- [Why we pump both compartments in Estero](https://expresssepticpumping.com/why-we-pump-both-tanks-estero-fl/): both-chamber pump-outs for Village homes still on a tank while sewer conversions proceed in phases.

- [Septic filter care](https://expresssepticpumping.com/septic-filter-care/): If a tank has an effluent filter, it should be checked and cleaned at every pump-out and whenever drains slow. Express cleans the filter on pump-outs and can show you how to keep it clean. A dirty filter can cause backups or slow drains, and wastewater can be pushed back into the house.
- [Septic filter cleaning service areas](https://expresssepticpumping.com/septic-filter-cleaning-service-areas/): hub listing homeowner effluent filter city pages in Southwest Florida.

- [Why good bacteria protect your septic tank and drain field](https://expresssepticpumping.com/septic-bacteria-drain-field/): Anaerobic bacteria in the tank break down solids and form sludge and scum layers. Aerobic bacteria and the biomat in drain-field soil treat effluent before it reaches groundwater. That matters in Southwest Florida's sandy soils and high water table. A healthy system normally gets the bacteria it needs from household waste; additives do not replace pumping. Express cleans the effluent filter on pump-outs.

## Spanish (Español)
Hablamos español. Someone can take your call in Spanish at (239) 451-3261. For a routine appointment, text the English keyword BOOK to that number (BOOK is the keyword that triggers the auto-reply; do not text RESERVAR). Or request a time on ServiceM8. Work is not booked until we confirm.
- [Bombeo de tanque séptico en el suroeste de Florida](https://expresssepticpumping.com/es/): Spanish main page. Residential pumping from $399.99.
